title: byte arithmetic produces int results
purpose: Observe the values produced by the operation.

provenance.origin: authored for OCS 0.1.0 from the cited contract text
provenance.expected_basis: spec 8.3: arithmetic never produces byte; byte+byte is int (no wrapping), so 255+1 = 256 compares equal to int 256. language owner decision, 21.10.2026 (D-046): different numeric categories interact only after an explicit cast; no implicit promotion, so byte+int needs .int().
